why: Chrome-style shared image cache behind a static API with ~105 callers (NSImage.icon, CmuxNextIcons); immutable CGImages keyed by value; no app state. IconRasters.shared is fileprivate (only NSImage.icon reaches it), bounded (512 bitmaps / 8 MB, LRU) and drops on memory pressure through its own kernel dispatch source, a second one beside the app's injected KernelMemoryPressureSource, because a static cache cannot take the injected one. Follow-up #32444 moves callers to an injected icon provider and removes this exception.
